stages.answer: FACT: The deeper background lies in settled farming communities of Baluchistan from the seventh millennium BCE and in later regional traditions such as Amri, Kot Diji, Hakra, Sothi-Siswal and Ravi.

stages.terms: Deep Teaching Unit 1: From Regional Cultures to Urban Integration — [CORE PRELIMS + CORE MAINS]: A city is not created by one large building.
stages.mechanism: A city is not created by one large building.
stages.consequence: The Early Harappan phase shows several regional communities developing some of these capacities.
stages.trap: A city is not created by one large building.
stages.answer: A city is not created by one large building.

stages.title: DEEP TEACHING UNIT 2: EXTENT, ECOLOGY AND THE URBAN-RURAL SYSTEM — [CORE PRELIMS + CORE MAINS]
stages.terms: Deep Teaching Unit 2: Extent, Ecology and the Urban-Rural System — [CORE PRELIMS + CORE MAINS]: “Indus Valley” is too narrow if it makes the civilization look like a single river-bank city.
stages.mechanism: Cities therefore depended on villages, pastoral areas and resource routes; they were not self-sufficient islands.
stages.consequence: Cities therefore depended on villages, pastoral areas and resource routes; they were not self-sufficient islands.
stages.trap: Cities therefore depended on villages, pastoral areas and resource routes; they were not self-sufficient islands.
stages.answer: “Indus Valley” is too narrow if it makes the civilization look like a single river-bank city.

stages.title: DEEP TEACHING UNIT 3: PLANNING, WATER AND EVERYDAY MAINTENANCE — [CORE PRELIMS + CORE MAINS]
stages.terms: Deep Teaching Unit 3: Planning, Water and Everyday Maintenance — [CORE PRELIMS + CORE MAINS]: Town planning means more than a grid seen from above.
stages.mechanism: Houses had wells, bathing areas and drains; street drains had to be laid out, cleaned and repaired.
stages.consequence: The contrast prevents the memorised rule “every Harappan town had a western citadel and eastern lower town” from becoming a false universal.
stages.trap: They do not reveal whether a monarch, council, merchant group or several local authorities organised it.
stages.answer: Town planning means more than a grid seen from above.

stages.title: DEEP TEACHING UNIT 4: THE ECONOMY AS A LINKED SYSTEM — [CORE PRELIMS + CORE MAINS]
stages.terms: Deep Teaching Unit 4: The Economy as a Linked System — [CORE PRELIMS + CORE MAINS]: A bead is not just an ornament for a list.
stages.mechanism: Standard weights prove exchange and shared norms; they do not by themselves prove taxation by a named central monarch.
stages.consequence: Each element makes more sense when connected to the next.
stages.trap: Do not learn crops, beads, weights and trade as disconnected lists.
stages.answer: Do not learn crops, beads, weights and trade as disconnected lists.

stages.title: DEEP TEACHING UNIT 5: EVIDENCE LADDER FOR SCRIPT, POLITY, SOCIETY AND RELIGION — [CORE MAINS]
stages.terms: Deep Teaching Unit 5: Evidence Ladder for Script, Polity, Society and Religion — [CORE MAINS]: Archaeology does not mean “we know nothing”; it means that the strength of a claim changes with the evidence.
stages.mechanism: Because the script is undeciphered, they cannot securely name a king, identify a god, translate a law or establish caste.
stages.consequence: Standardisation therefore permits several models--central state, city-states or corporate elites.
stages.trap: Archaeology does not mean “we know nothing”; it means that the strength of a claim changes with the evidence.
stages.answer: Archaeology does not mean “we know nothing”; it means that the strength of a claim changes with the evidence.

stages.title: DEEP TEACHING UNIT 6: DE-URBANISATION AS CAUSAL SEQUENCE AND CONTINUITY — [CORE PRELIMS + CORE MAINS]
stages.terms: Deep Teaching Unit 6: De-urbanisation as Causal Sequence and Continuity — [CORE PRELIMS + CORE MAINS]: It is not a licence to choose one dramatic event.
stages.mechanism: River shifts, local water stress, ecological change, changing external exchange and internal reorganisation are possible contributors whose weight differs by region and site.
stages.consequence: River shifts, local water stress, ecological change, changing external exchange and internal reorganisation are possible contributors whose weight differs by region and site.
stages.trap: It is not a licence to choose one dramatic event.
stages.answer: “Decline” asks why a particular city-centred system lost some urban features.

stages.title: DEEP TEACHING UNIT 7: SITE MEMORY METHOD AND THE FIVE-SENTENCE ANSWER — [CORE PRELIMS + CORE MAINS]
stages.terms: Deep Teaching Unit 7: Site Memory Method and the Five-Sentence Answer — [CORE PRELIMS + CORE MAINS]: Memory improves when a site is stored as a triad rather than as an isolated name.
stages.mechanism: Eliminate by geography and feature: a Rajasthan farming association points toward Kalibangan, a Kutch water/signboard pair toward Dholavira, and a Sindh water monument toward Mohenjo-daro.
stages.consequence: Exam link: five-sentence answer. (1) Define the issue. (2) Make one claim. (3) attach a named site/material example. (4) add the evidence limit or regional contrast. (5) give a balanced verdict.
stages.trap: Memory improves when a site is stored as a triad rather than as an isolated name.
stages.answer: Memory improves when a site is stored as a triad rather than as an isolated name.
